notes.title: Localization Feedback Received and Price Adjustments
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Since the multi-language version update, we've received quite a lot of feedback and suggestions. We cannot thank you enough for your huge support! Please rest assured that we have noted every comment and message you've left, and we'll do our best to fix the issues. However, the game supports many languages right now and it will take us some time to locate the problems and get them resolved. We sincerely ask for your patience and understanding.

We'd like to make another announcement regarding the game pricing. Now that Tales of the Neon Sea is very close to its complete form. We have made the decision to follow the suggested rate on Steam and make some pricing adjustments. Thanks again for all of your support and love! Hope you will all have an amazing journey in the world of Tales of the Neon Sea!

notes.title: May 4th: solved issues of getting achievements
notes.notes:
In this update, we fixed the issue of achievements being unable to be done normally. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

We will continue working hard to optimize the game to provide you with a better gaming experience.

notes.title: Multi-language Support Available Now!
notes.notes:
Thanks to our incredible community, Tales of the Neon Sea now has a bunch of new languages available! [b]You can now play the game in Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Portugal), Russian, Italian, Hungarian, and Ukrainian.[/b]

Can't wait to see more players join Rex on his thrilling cyberpunk mystery-solving journey!


Before you dive in, here are some tips:

1. If you're using a non-16:9 screen, it is recommended to set it to window mode to play the game.
2. If you're playing on a Steam Deck, we recommend setting it to window mode and cranking up the resolution to 1280x720 for the best visuals.


Thanks again for all your huge support! Have fun in the world of Tales of the Neon Sea!

notes.title: Final Chapter is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi, Detectives, 
It's been a year since The Tale of The Neon Sea went online. We would like to express our sincere appreciation of your support and encouragement. After the game went online last year, we have been keeping an open ear to all the feedback from the players, and we have been adjusting and upgrading the game accordingly. 

We are doing this because we are determined to provide you with the best game experience. At the same time, we have been working hard on the last chapter of the story. Finally, the Finale of The Tale of The Neon Sea is ready to meet you guys!  

You will not only experience several upgraded parts of the game, but also see Finale of The Tale of The Neon Sea---The Final Journey going online at the same time! 
To celebrate the Finale's going online, we are giving the biggest discount we have ever had in a limited period of time---60% off! (Begin from 10:00AM June 8th PST) If you are a fan of The Tale of The Neon Sea, don't miss the chance! Let's give a perfect ending to this exciting detection journey!   

And Soundtrack also out today:

In the latest update, we have further optimized the level process, and changed the tasks that affect the main tasks experience into side-line tasks.
We have improved and adjusted the narrative content of the game, as well as added more description, animation presentation and interaction, in order to make the story line stands out. 
Some adjustment may lead to errors on saved games and process. When you are playing, you are able to press (Chapter selection) to read the node of the last chapter to continue with your game.

notes.title: Update 6.6
Tales of the Neon Sea going to Gfusion 2019 Beijing China
notes.notes:
Detectives, it’s been over a week since Tales of the Neon Sea released on Steam, and your comments and suggestions have been pouring in ever since. As mentioned in our previous update, we’ve been paying a lot of attention to your feedback and are actively using this to help shape and improve the current experience. Sections we are focusing on include the gang elevators and conveyors in the final chapter, as well as the sonar puzzle on the abandoned ship. These have caused problems and we intend to rectify those.

We’ve also been taking general feedback on board, regarding areas such as puzzles, level design, story pacing, and more. We don’t want to dramatically change the game that many of our players love, but we do want improve on these areas in order to provide a more well-rounded experience. Thanks again for all your support, and please keep the feedback coming!

We are going to attend Gfusion 2019 Beijing China, more detail please check the office page:
https://www.gcores.com/fusion2019 (only in Chinese)

notes.title: Untitled
Update 5.03
notes.notes:
1. Updated and optimised the gameplay of Chapter 2, removing some redundant elements. This update may cause data errors for players who were stuck on sections that have now been changed or removed. 
If you are currently on Miracle Street, it is recommended to restart from “Brank! The Missing Person" using the "Chapter Selection” screen on the main menu. If you are at the old Hydroelectric Plant area, it is recommended to restart from “Mistake or Trap? Uncovered Tracks".

2. Updated Combination Benches to let players know which components can be combined to form new items.

3. Optimized the gear system to make it clearer which items can be collected;

4. Optimized several puzzles and removed some repetitive puzzles.

5. Unlocking puzzles have been streamlined.

6. The playing cards in the wine cellar have been replaced.

7. Fixed a number of bugs.

8. Removed German and Spanish from the store page. If you are playing with either of these two languages, please do not change language in the game as this will remove them. Feedback has confirmed that these two language packs are not in a good state. We will review these and update at a later point.

notes.title: Developer Update: Acting on Your Valuable Feedback
notes.notes:
Following the release of Tales of the Neon Sea, we’ve received lots of comments and feedback regarding the experience as it currently stands. While much of this has been positive, there’s also been some very useful criticism that has helped us view the game from a new perspective. 

To be more specific, some players have reported that the experience suffers during the mid to late stages of the game. Here, the amount of puzzles ramps up and this can cause frustration and detract from the storyline.

Our intention was to keep players engaged with challenging puzzles, however it is clear that our execution was flawed in some cases. We apologise to any players who felt their experience of the game suffered as they passed the midway point and came closer to the end. 

We’ve been collecting this feedback across all channels, and are already in the process of making adjustments to some of the more difficult sections, removing some redundant elements, and generally doing our best to make good on our original vision for a fun and engaging experience throughout. We want to thank everyone who has played our game, and all those who took time to leave valuable feedback. We’ll continue working hard, and we’re very grateful for all your support.

Developer Team

notes.title: Tales Of The Neon Sea is a cyberpunk detect 'em up with a cat
notes.notes:
It is the future and not only have vandals replaced almost all bulbs with pink and green neon lights, someone is doing murder too. Enter us, a former detective now living hard as a private eye, to solve crime in Tales Of The Neon Sea. The puzzle-o-adventure-a-platform game launched yesterday and I cannot deny that a fair chunk of my interest is driven by occasionally getting to play as his catpal, chatting with other cats and exploring places our big trenchcoated idiot can’t reach. Cats: they are good. Crime: it is bad. This game: it sounds like something I want to see more of?

notes.title: Almost there!
notes.notes:
Tales of the Neon Sea releases tomorrow, and we’re barely able to contain our excitement! Here are some important points regarding the release version of the game:

1. The game will be playable from 4.30 1:00am PDT.
2. The retail price is $16.99 / €13.99, and there will be 10% off for the first week.
3. This release contains about 12-15 hours of gameplay, and features the first three chapters of a larger story arc. We aim to release following chapters of the main storyline for free sometime in the autumn.
4. Regarding languages, the game supports  English, Chinese, German, Spanish, French and Japanese. However, French and Japanese will be removed from the store page because the quality still needs time to improve. You may still select these languages in the game.

We are very grateful for all your support, and we hope you enjoy Tales of the Neon Sea! 
Find us on twitter @ZdcInteractive if you have any questions or feedback.
